findings.text: THE PERSON A PLAYER STANDS NEXT TO IS 780 TRIANGLES. populace.corridor_lod bakes the corridor crowd at chain level 4 because the crowd is INSTANCED against a shared library and level 0 would cost 510,720 resident triangles -- populace says so in its own note and calls it a stated compromise. The consequence is visible in right-half.png at 0.62 m: an octagonal skull, no eyes, no nose, no ears, no fingers, because level 4 carries features='no_detail' and 8 radial segments. Garment construction now reads at that level; the FACE does not, and no amount of work inside costume.py can fix it. What would raise it is runtime LOD -- npc.gd already holds each person's parts and could swap them.

Three of the five construction pieces are authority-5 extrapolations (placket, hem, boot top) and one is authority 2 already written down in this file and never built (the cuff, off Sheridan.jpg, corroborated in Zach Allan in security uniform.jpg). No frame in reference/ resolves a civilian wrist or hem on this station, so the appearance has not been compared side by side against an authority-1 or -2 frame at matched camera, which is what FIDELITY 5 asks. INV-814 records what would overturn each.

The cost is measured and bounded -- +25% triangles and +2 primitives a figure, both gated, both with a control -- but NPCs still have no allowance of their own; they are folded into a frame total whose structure component is over budget. Carried from round 2 and not addressed here.

value_jitter is drawn per individual and still reaches nothing. Reaching it needs a per-instance shader parameter this pipeline does not have -- one material per fabric, drawn as instances of a shared library. Recorded in INV-815 rather than left to be rediscovered.

Round 2: 'each garment reads as one flat value ... no variation within a garment'. The cause was structural: the yoke was a SPAN inside the torso part and animation.rig resolves one material per PART, so 0 of 40 corridor walkers on the built blue/0/0 deck carried any npc_cloth_trim group. Closed by building construction as parts; measured 0/96 -> 96/96 by station/npc/costume.py --construct against its own --legacy control.

Round 2: 'the assertions exist and do not execute'. --construct is a seconds-long gate with no build and no GPU, it runs the shipped path rather than this module's own mesh, and it has been shown failing.
